content: In 2 Corinthians, Paul says anyone in Christ is a new what?
explanation: The old has passed away. “Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation.” (2 Corinthians 5:17, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, Paul says we walk by faith, not by what?
explanation: We trust what we cannot see. “For we walk by faith, not by sight.” (2 Corinthians 5:7, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, what kind of giver does God love?
explanation: Give from the heart. “For God loves a cheerful giver.” (2 Corinthians 9:7, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, the Lord told Paul, “My grace is sufficient for…”
explanation: His power is perfected in weakness. “My grace is sufficient for you, for My power is perfected in weakness.” (2 Corinthians 12:9, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, Paul says, “When I am weak, then I am…”
explanation: Christ's power rests on him. “For when I am weak, then I am strong.” (2 Corinthians 12:10, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, Paul calls God the God of all what?
explanation: He comforts us in all troubles. “the Father of compassion and the God of all comfort” (2 Corinthians 1:3, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, Paul says we have this treasure in jars made of what?
explanation: The power is from God, not us. “Now we have this treasure in jars of clay” (2 Corinthians 4:7, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, Paul says believers are ambassadors for whom?
explanation: God appeals through us. “Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ” (2 Corinthians 5:20, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, how many times did Paul say he was shipwrecked?
explanation: He suffered much for the gospel. “three times I was shipwrecked.” (2 Corinthians 11:25, BSB)

content: How does Paul close 2 Corinthians?
explanation: Grace, love, and fellowship. “The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with all of you.” (2 Corinthians 13:14, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, why does God comfort us in our troubles?
explanation: Comfort is passed on. “so that we can comfort those in any trouble with the comfort we ourselves have received from God.” (2 Corinthians 1:4, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, what is being renewed day by day?
explanation: So we do not lose heart. “yet our inner self is being renewed day by day.” (2 Corinthians 4:16, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, what does Paul say is eternal?
explanation: What is seen is temporary. “For what is seen is temporary, but what is unseen is eternal.” (2 Corinthians 4:18, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, Paul calls the believers a letter from Christ written on what?
explanation: Written by the Spirit, not ink. “not on tablets of stone but on tablets of human hearts.” (2 Corinthians 3:3, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, though Christ was rich, what did He become for our sakes?
explanation: So we might become rich. “that though He was rich, yet for your sakes He became poor” (2 Corinthians 8:9, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, whoever sows generously will also do what?
explanation: Generosity brings blessing. “and whoever sows generously will also reap generously.” (2 Corinthians 9:6, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, what was Paul given to keep him from becoming conceited?
explanation: He pleaded for it to be removed. “I was given a thorn in my flesh” (2 Corinthians 12:7, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, how many times did Paul plead for his thorn to be taken away?
explanation: God's grace was enough. “Three times I pleaded with the Lord to take it away from me.” (2 Corinthians 12:8, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, how did Paul escape the governor in Damascus?
explanation: Through a window in the wall. “But I was lowered in a basket through a window in the wall and escaped his grasp.” (2 Corinthians 11:33, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, Paul asks what fellowship light has with what?
explanation: Do not be unequally yoked. “Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?” (2 Corinthians 6:14, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, in whom should anyone who boasts boast?
explanation: All credit belongs to God. “Let him who boasts boast in the Lord.” (2 Corinthians 10:17, BSB)

content: Who joined Paul in greeting the church at Corinth in 2 Corinthians?
explanation: The letter also went to Achaia. “and Timothy our brother, To the church of God in Corinth” (2 Corinthians 1:1, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, Paul says a man in Christ was caught up to which heaven?
explanation: It was fourteen years earlier. “was caught up to the third heaven.” (2 Corinthians 12:2, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, under which king did the Damascus governor try to arrest Paul?
explanation: Paul escaped in a basket. “In Damascus, the governor under King Aretas secured the city” (2 Corinthians 11:32, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, whose arrival comforted Paul?
explanation: God comforts the downcast. “comforted us by the arrival of Titus” (2 Corinthians 7:6, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, how many times did Paul receive forty lashes minus one?
explanation: He listed his sufferings. “Five times I received from the Jews the forty lashes minus one.” (2 Corinthians 11:24, BSB)

content: In 2 Corinthians, how long did Paul say he spent in the open sea?
explanation: It was after a shipwreck. “I spent a night and a day in the open sea.” (2 Corinthians 11:25, BSB)
